items.ask: Prorate a mid-cycle plan change by the day, or start the new price at the next cycle?

review.if_unanswered: BIL-306 stays in In Progress with the plan change unpriced.

options.effect: The next run charges or credits the difference for the days left in the cycle.
options.label: Prorate by the day

tradeoffs.text: Customers pay for what they use.

options.effect: The next run keeps the old price until the cycle ends and starts the new one after.
options.label: Start at the next cycle

tradeoffs.text: An upgrade waits up to a month for its price.

review.question: BIL-306 (Proration when a plan changes mid-cycle) changes a customer's plan in the middle of a billing cycle. Should the price change prorate by the day, or start at the next cycle?
review.recommendation_reason: Daily proration is what the pricing page promises.
review.title: Prorate a mid-cycle plan change by the day, or start the new price at the next cycle?
review.why: The run reached the plan change and found no rule for the days left in the cycle. The pricing page promises a fair charge.

items.title: Proration when a plan changes mid-cycle
